title: Hello.
intro: One small word. A lot riding on it. A prospect to reach, a customer to help, a service request that can't wait. AtomsAI applications handle those conversations and what follows.

sections.title: Every hello sets work in motion
intro: For a service business, it's a job to assess, book, and finish. For a sales or support team, it's the next step with that customer. We build applications around what each business needs to happen next.

sections.title: "Can someone come today?"
sections.label: ServiceAgent
intro: For a homeowner, it's one question. For a service business, there's a job to assess, a technician to schedule, and a customer to look after.
ServiceAgent brings AI into the day-to-day running of HVAC, plumbing, electrical, and other home-service businesses, handling the office work around every job.

blocks.title: Know what the job needs
body: Answer calls around the clock, ask trade-specific questions, capture job details, and identify requests that need urgent attention.

blocks.title: Get the right visit booked
body: Turn service requests into appointments, coordinate technician availability, and handle schedule changes as the day unfolds.

blocks.title: Keep customers in the loop
body: Send confirmations, reminders, and updates, with the details of each job available when customers call back.

blocks.title: See the job through to payment
body: Keep estimates, invoices, payments, and follow-ups connected to the work, with less office administration between jobs.

blocks.title: Make today's customers tomorrow's business
body: Stay in touch after the job with timely follow-ups, review requests, and opportunities to bring customers back.

sections.title: "You have my details, right?"
sections.label: JustCall
intro: Your CRM holds the context. JustCall puts it to work through calls, texts, and AI, then brings the outcomes back to inform what happens next.

blocks.title: Make the calling hour count
body: Reach more prospects with Power, Dynamic, or Predictive dialing, using CRM context and call outcomes to guide your next attempt.
blocks.quote: “You can only make so many dials a day. When your connect rate triples, it changes everything.”
blocks.attribution: Warren Lentz · Founder and CEO, Yellowstone Local

blocks.title: Be there when customers call
body: Route callers by need and availability, with AI answering the calls you choose and your team ready to step in.
blocks.quote: “In 12 months, JustCall helped customer response times go from a couple of days to within a day.”
blocks.attribution: Reed Lewallen · Manager of Investor Care, CrowdStreet

blocks.title: Carry the conversation into SMS
body: Trigger timely texts from CRM activity or call outcomes, with two-way replies and follow-ups connected to the customer record.
blocks.quote: “We were converting about 30% of inbound leads to appointments. … We brought that appointment-conversion rate up to 50%.”
blocks.attribution: Brian Mason · Chief Financial Officer, SCSP Solar
blocks.metric: A text within seconds of the form fill

blocks.title: Give AI a job and a goal
body: Shape voice agents around your business knowledge, qualification criteria, and desired outcomes, with clear rules for human handoffs.
blocks.quote: “The AI is great at handling clear-cut policy questions like warranty timelines in a calm, consistent way. That means our agents can spend their time on the conversations that really need a human touch.”

blocks.title: Make the next conversation better
body: Turn calls into summaries, AI scores, and coaching insights that help managers spot gaps and reps improve their next conversation.
blocks.quote: “Everything gets logged: recordings, call details, even transcripts. It’s a huge time-saver for the team and gives managers real-time insights.”
blocks.attribution: Warren Lentz · Founder and CEO, Yellowstone Local

blocks.quote: “Through the variety of businesses I’ve scaled, JustCall has been a go-to. It’s reliable, easy to set up, and integrates deeply with all the tools we use.”
blocks.attribution: Warren Lentz · Founder and CEO, Yellowstone Local

blocks.quote: “Click-to-dial from HubSpot, instant call logging, and real-time reporting. JustCall was exactly what we needed to scale efficiently.”

blocks.quote: “We switched to JustCall for the AI, but just as much for how little downtime you have.”
“Don’t waste your time or try anything else. When I saw JustCall, I said, ‘Oh wow. I wish I had done this five years ago.’”
